---
title: "CLIAR Vintage Comparison: Compiled Indicators"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  word_document:
    reference_docx: reference_landscape.docx
params:
  comparison: NULL
  share_threshold: 5
  workbook: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
cmp    <- params$comparison
labels <- cmp$settings$labels
thr    <- params$share_threshold
about  <- stats::setNames(cmp$about$value, cmp$about$item)

fmt_n   <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
fmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", sprintf("%.1f%%", x))

# landscape Letter leaves 9.5in between margins; widths must not exceed it
ft <- function(df, widths) {
  flextable::flextable(df) |>
    flextable::width(width = widths) |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::valign(valign = "top", part = "body") |>
    flextable::theme_vanilla()
}

n_status  <- function(s) cmp$summary$n[cmp$summary$status == s]
published <- sum(cmp$summary$n[cmp$summary$status %in% c("Same", "Revised", "Dropped")])
```

This report compares the **`r labels[["latest"]]`** vintage of the compiled
indicators (`r about[["Latest: years"]]`) with the **`r labels[["previous"]]`**
vintage already published (`r about[["Previous: years"]]`), across
`r about[["Variables compared"]]` variables present in both. Cell-level details
are in the accompanying workbook, *`r params$workbook`*.

# 1. Overview

Of the `r fmt_n(published)` values already published,
`r fmt_pct(100 * n_status("Same") / published)` are unchanged,
`r fmt_pct(100 * n_status("Revised") / published)` were revised and
`r fmt_pct(100 * n_status("Dropped") / published)` are missing from the latest
vintage. The latest vintage also adds `r fmt_n(n_status("Added (new period)"))`
values for years after `r cmp$settings$last_year` and
`r fmt_n(n_status("Added (backfilled)"))` values for years already covered.

```{r overview}
cmp$summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Status                 = as.character(.data$status),
    Cells                  = fmt_n(.data$n),
    `Share of published`   = fmt_pct(.data$pct_of_published)
  ) |>
  ft(c(3.0, 2.0, 2.0))
```

# 2. Structural changes

```{r structure, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(cmp$structure) == 0) {
  cat("The two vintages have the same variables, countries and years.\n")
} else {
  cmp$structure |>
    dplyr::summarise(Values = paste(.data$value, collapse = ", "), Count = dplyr::n(), .by = c("type", "change")) |>
    dplyr::transmute(Type = .data$type, Change = .data$change, Count = .data$Count, Values = .data$Values) |>
    ft(c(1.0, 1.8, 0.7, 6.0)) |>
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd()
}
```

# 3. Changes by source

```{r by-source}
cmp$by_source |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Source        = dplyr::coalesce(.data$source, "(not in metadata)"),
    Variables     = .data$variables,
    Published     = fmt_n(.data$published),
    `% same`      = fmt_pct(.data$pct_same),
    `% revised`   = fmt_pct(.data$pct_revised),
    `% dropped`   = fmt_pct(.data$pct_dropped),
    Added         = fmt_n(.data$added)
  ) |>
  ft(c(3.0, 0.9, 1.1, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.1))
```

# 4. Variables with more than `r thr`% of published values dropped

```{r dropped, results = "asis"}
dropped <- cmp$variables |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$pct_dropped > thr) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$pct_dropped))
if (nrow(dropped) == 0) {
  cat("No variable lost more than ", thr, "% of its published values.\n", sep = "")
} else {
  dropped |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Variable    = .data$variable,
      Name        = .data$var_name,
      Source      = .data$source,
      Published   = fmt_n(.data$published),
      Dropped     = fmt_n(.data$Dropped),
      `% dropped` = fmt_pct(.data$pct_dropped)
    ) |>
    ft(c(1.9, 2.6, 2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)) |>
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd()
}
```

# 5. Variables with more than `r thr`% of published values revised

```{r revised, results = "asis"}
revised <- cmp$variables |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$pct_revised > thr) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$pct_revised))
if (nrow(revised) == 0) {
  cat("No variable had more than ", thr, "% of its published values revised.\n", sep = "")
} else {
  revised |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Variable                 = .data$variable,
      Name                     = .data$var_name,
      Source                   = .data$source,
      Published                = fmt_n(.data$published),
      `% revised`              = fmt_pct(.data$pct_revised),
      `Median % change`        = fmt_pct(.data$median_abs_pct_change)
    ) |>
    ft(c(1.9, 2.6, 2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)) |>
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd()
}
```

# 6. New observations by source

```{r added}
cmp$by_source |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$added > 0) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$added)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Source                                              = dplyr::coalesce(.data$source, "(not in metadata)"),
    !!paste0("New period (after ", cmp$settings$last_year, ")") := fmt_n(.data$`Added (new period)`),
    Backfilled                                          = fmt_n(.data$`Added (backfilled)`),
    Total                                               = fmt_n(.data$added)
  ) |>
  ft(c(4.0, 2.0, 1.75, 1.75))
```

# Appendix: status definitions

- **Same**: published value unchanged, within the tolerance (`r about[["Tolerance"]]`).
- **Revised**: published value changed by more than the tolerance.
- **Dropped**: published value is missing from the latest vintage.
- **Added (backfilled)**: new value for a year the previous vintage already covered.
- **Added (new period)**: new value for a year after the previous vintage's last year (`r cmp$settings$last_year`).
